claim: When an ActiveMQ engine version reaches end of support, Amazon MQ upgrades all brokers on that version to the next supported version automatically. The upgrade takes place during the broker's scheduled maintenance windows, within the 45 days following the end-of-support date.
question: What happens when an Amazon MQ engine version reaches end of support?

values.display: within the 45 days following the end-of-support date

qualifiers.scope: Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ engine versions at end of support
qualifiers.condition: During the broker's scheduled maintenance windows.

evidence.quote: When a version reaches end of support, Amazon MQ upgrades all brokers on this version to the next supported version automatically. This upgrade takes place during your broker's scheduled maintenance windows, within the 45 days following the end-of-support date.

claim: You cannot create new Amazon MQ brokers on engine versions scheduled for end of support within 30 days of the end of support date.
question: Can you create a new Amazon MQ broker on an engine version close to end of support?

values.display: within 30 days of the end of support date

qualifiers.scope: new Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ brokers on versions scheduled for end of support
